semesters.notes: 16 units = 4 primary picks (MA3210, ST3131, ST3236, ST3248), each 'Counted, if NUS accepts you into it'. Backup ST4253 (4 units, ~10 h/wk) is not in the 16; NUS's form lists 20 units for Sem 1 (form nos. 1-5). Nothing is marked 'to confirm' or 'if invited'. NUS minimum 12 units to be admitted; max 20 (NUS Global) or 23 (brochure): ask NUS above 20. About 40 h/wk at NUS's 2.5 h per unit; 13 teaching weeks + 2 exam weeks.

16 units = 4 primary picks (ST4234, MA4251, ST3247, ST2137), each 'Counted, if NUS accepts you into it'. Two of them are level 4000 (GRO: usually not available to exchange students), so 8 of the 16 units are at real risk; backup ST4248 (4 units) is also level 4000 and needs ST3131+ST3248. NUS's form lists 20 units for Sem 2. NUS has asked full-year students to choose Sem 2 courses later (2018/19 info sheet): check with NUS whether to list them now. About 40 h/wk.

year.courses: NUS's 2026/27 courses and exchange (NG) course list, updated 01 Sep 2026 (restrictions 31 Aug 2026). The PDF was made 12 Nov 2026, during 2026/27 Sem 1, so if the exchange is in 2027/28 every course must be rechecked against the 2027/28 list (NUS publishes Sem 1's in March/April).
year.exams: NUS's 2026/27 exam timetable: Sem 1 exams 21-28 Nov 2026, Sem 2 exams 26 Apr - 4 May 2027 (Singapore time). A 2027/28 exchange would have different dates (timetable published mid-July).

disagreements: No substantive disagreement on courses, ranks, form numbers, units, exams or exchange status. Differences: the PDF gives level as a band ('Level 1000–3000, undergraduate' / 'Level 4000, Honours') where the link gives the exact level (2000/3000/4000); the link's header says 'Sem 2 · 3rd-year exchange student' and lists the Sem 2 form table before Sem 1, while the PDF title says 'Sem 1 and Sem 2' and shows Sem 1 first; the link page shows no prerequisites, preclusions or course descriptions (only the PDF has them); the PDF adds the faculty (Science) and the estimated-study-time line.
